findings.family_work: A published interview records Sandeep Mohapatra providing a shooting script, learning subtitle work and consulting family; credit reconstruction involved an unnamed NID friend. Retain reported-testimony attribution.
findings.design: MAMI2024 names Ramakanta Mohanty and Bijay K. Mahapatra as production designers, without assigning specific set-building acts.
findings.credit_distinctions: Retain joint story versus screenplay, actor versus production company, and family participation versus restoration authorship.

preferred_change.paragraph: The family’s contribution included detailed work on the film itself. Sandeep Mohapatra told Scroll that he supplied his father’s shooting script and taught himself to work on the new subtitles in his spare time. He consulted his mother and siblings; an unnamed friend from the National Institute of Design helped recreate damaged credits.[^family-work]
